review.message: apply_discount applies the discount only when total > 100, but the rule requires 10% off for totals of at least 100 (>= 100).
paginate returns items[start:start + size + 1], which can return size + 1 items, violating the rule of at most `size` items per page.
apply_discount uses `total > 100`, but the rule requires 10% off for totals of AT LEAST 100 (total >= 100). A total of exactly 100 incorrectly receives no discount.
paginate returns size + 1 items, violating the rule to return AT MOST `size` items for the given page.
paginate returns size + 1 items because the slice end is start + size + 1, violating the rule that it returns at most `size` items.
